domain(person,[emmy]).

% Emmy does not inspire others.
axiom(s1, not(inspire(emmy))).

% If Emmy is dedicated to archaeology, then she can either make groundbreaking discoveries or become a leading expert, but not both.
axiom(s2, implies(dedicated_to_archaeology(emmy), xor(make_groundbreaking_discoveries(emmy), become_a_leading_expert(emmy)))).

% If Emmy advances historical knowledge, then she will gain recognition.
axiom(s3, implies(advances_historical_knowledge(emmy), gain_recognition(emmy))).

% Emmy either pursues alternate careers or is dedicated to archaeology, but not both.
axiom(s4, xor(pursues_alternate_careers(emmy), dedicated_to_archaeology(emmy))).

% If Emmy either makes groundbreaking discoveries or uncovers lost artifacts (but not both), then she advances historical knowledge.
axiom(s5, implies(xor(make_groundbreaking_discoveries(emmy), uncovers_lost_artifacts(emmy)), advances_historical_knowledge(emmy))).

% Anyone who uncovers lost artifacts or deciphers ancient texts can shed new light on history.
axiom(s6, rule([or(uncovers_lost_artifacts(X), deciphers_ancient_texts(X))], sheds_new_light_on_history(X))).

% Emmy does not gain recognition.
axiom(s7, not(gain_recognition(emmy))).

% If Emmy sheds new light on history, then she will inspire others.
axiom(s8, implies(sheds_new_light_on_history(emmy), inspire(emmy))).

% Emmy does not pursue alternate careers.
axiom(s9, not(pursues_alternate_careers(emmy))).
